other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker)
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000 or below
Applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Applicant must not be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab and deposit contributions regularly
The child of the member must be mentally retarded or disabled
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 per year for the care of mentally retarded children.
